purpose: validate, not extend. CAM-EXP-006.1 builds no new calibration method.

frame_balanced.step_1_joint_to_hand: median over joints of the reprojection error in px
frame_balanced.step_2_hands_to_frame: median over the usable hands in that frame, so a one-hand frame and a two-hand frame each count as exactly one frame
frame_balanced.step_3_frames_to_view: mean, in log space, of the per-frame scores - UNCHANGED from CAM-EXP-006
frame_balanced.secondary_sensitivity_only: STRICT_MEDIAN_FRAME_SENSITIVITY (median rather than mean across frames)

synthetic.grid: identical to CAM-EXP-006: 121 log-uniform points, gamma in [0.25, 5.0], gamma = f / max(W, H)

SYNTH_GENERIC_STRONG_PERSPECTIVE.shape: deterministic non-coplanar random cloud in a unit box, rejected and redrawn if its best-fit-plane residual is degenerate

SYNTH_HAND_STRONG_PERSPECTIVE.shape: root-relative OTHER_CAMERA_ONLY_REFERENCE_3D hands, sampled deterministically at uniform stride from the frozen CAM-006 manifest order
SYNTH_HAND_STRONG_PERSPECTIVE.selection_independence: stride sampling over the manifest order; no focal error and no GT focal took any part

synthetic.distortion_provenance: median over the 245 provided GigaHands cameras; rig metadata, target-independent
synthetic.safety: every trial checks that all points have Z > 0 in the camera frame and project inside a generous image margin
synthetic.primary_analysis_for_planarity: depth_scale 0.25 and 0.1; the exactly coplanar 0.0 endpoint is diagnostic only because it forces a different PnP back-end
synthetic.rule: noise-sweep results are never used to tune a real-data threshold

thresholds.fires_if: median relative focal error changes by >= 10 percentage points, OR flat-profile share changes by >= 10 pp, OR cleanly-identifiable share changes by >= 10 pp

median relative focal error falls by >= 25 % in relative terms, OR identifiable share rises by >= 20 pp, OR flat share falls by >= 20 pp, OR focal tracking correlation becomes materially positive with a cluster-bootstrap CI excluding zero
N=16 median relative focal error differs by more than 5 percentage points from 202.16 %, or the flat share differs by more than 5 pp from 86.86 %
fewer than 20 views or fewer than 8 physical cameras

constant_rig_focal_oracle.name: CONSTANT_RIG_FOCAL_ORACLE
constant_rig_focal_oracle.history: the constant-rig focal confound was discovered post hoc in CAM-EXP-005. It was therefore already known before CAM-EXP-006 began, and is a genuinely pre-registered control in CAM-006 and CAM-006.1. The self-contradictory label 'PRE_REGISTERED_POST_HOC' must not be used.

separation_rule: synthetic results validate the implementation and the theory; real GigaHands results are the empirical evidence. They are reported in separate tables and figures and are never substituted for one another.
honesty_rules: a result that overturns CAM-EXP-006 is reported unchanged
a result that supports CAM-EXP-006 is not generalised beyond the evaluated GigaHands regime and this profiled-PnP formulation
GT focal MAGNITUDE is never a solver input in any condition
the real PLANARIZED control is sensitivity evidence only, because its PnP back-end differs
